hook: Windows 11 with BitLocker, running on Apple's virtualization.
hookText: A TPM BitLocker trusts, on a Mac

beats.say: Windows 11 expects Secure Boot and a TPM 2.0, but Apple's Virtualization framework has no TPM device at all, and its firmware logs no boot measurements.
From MacVisor 27.2.1, new Windows 11 VMs get Secure Boot and a TPM 2.0 anyway. BitLocker seals to it and unlocks at each start.
To move a VM to another Mac, you export the TPM sealed with a passphrase: 600,000 rounds of PBKDF2, then AES-256.
